reason: Conversation 1 correctly explained dE as a door-not-closed/locked error, asked the homeowner to check the seal, identified the bulging king-size duvet as the cause, confirmed it with a towel test, and closed with sensible loading advice and no part or engineer recommendation - matching the hidden truth exactly. Conversation 2 was handed the decisive clue (duvet corner squashed in the seal, door springing back) and still declared the cause 'not confirmed', failed to suggest removing the duvet, and escalated to an engineer for a no-fault overload. Neither raised safety problems, but Conversation 2's unnecessary escalation and refusal to act on obvious evidence left the homeowner with an unresolved, non-existent fault.
